text: My daily routine is simple but consistent, which helps me stay organized. I wake up at six-thirty every morning, and after brushing my teeth, I drink a glass of water and stretch for five minutes. Breakfast is quick—usually oatmeal and coffee—while I check the news. From nine to five, I work at a graphic design company, where I focus on projects and take short breaks every two hours. After work, I exercise for about forty-five minutes, alternating between jogging and strength training. In the evening, I cook dinner, read a book or watch a show, and prepare my clothes for the next day. I am usually in bed by ten-thirty. This routine keeps me healthy and productive.
